subject: Rodent Infestation at Brooks Park Apartments
overview: The Board addressed ongoing sanitary violations and rodent infestations at Brooks Park Apartments, warning of potential building condemnation. They also approved a food safety variance and introduced new youth prevention staffing.

items.title: Minutes and 40 Century Street Update
items.summary: Approved the minutes from June 16, 2026, and voted to close a code enforcement complaint for 40 Century Street upon final satisfaction of remaining safety violations.

items.title: Ebisuya Sushi Rice Variance
items.summary: Approved a variance for sushi rice acidification based on a submitted HACCP plan to satisfy food safety requirements for non-temperature controlled storage.

items.title: Youth Prevention Activities
items.summary: Introduced the new Prevention and Wellness Coordinator and reviewed summer youth programs, including a substance use diversion program that served 50 students during the school year.

items.title: Brooks Park Apartments Code Violations
items.summary: Discussed a severe and ongoing Norway rat infestation and trash overflow at 208 Main Street that has persisted since December despite multiple fines. The Board warned management that the building faces potential condemnation if professional remediation and integrated pest management plans are not verified immediately.

items.title: Mobile Health Van and Department Updates
items.summary: Announced a monthly mobile health clinic starting August 25 at Clipper Ship Park to provide screenings and vaccines regardless of insurance or immigration status.

items.title: Other Business
items.summary: Voted to cancel the August meeting and resume on September 15.
